gloss: to devise, to plot, to set up

definitions.gloss: to devise, to plot, to scheme
definitions.explanation: To plan or arrange something in advance, especially something secretive or strategic. Often implies a hidden agenda or a carefully laid plan.

definitions.gloss: to set up, to construct (a mechanism or system)
definitions.explanation: To build or arrange a mechanism, device, or system so that it functions in a particular way.

examples.japanese: {誰|だれ}かが{裏|うら}で{仕組|しく}んだことだ。
examples.english: Someone plotted this behind the scenes.

examples.japanese: {最初|さいしょ}から{仕組|しく}まれた{計画|けいかく}だったらしい。
examples.english: It seems it was a scheme planned from the very beginning.

examples.japanese: {時計|とけい}の{中|なか}を{仕組|しく}む。
examples.english: To construct the mechanism inside a clock.

examples.japanese: ボタンを{押|お}すと{音|おと}が{鳴|な}るように{仕組|しく}んだ。
examples.english: I set it up so that a sound plays when the button is pressed.

examples.japanese: {自動|じどう}で{水|みず}がまかれるように{仕組|しく}んである。
examples.english: It is set up so that water is sprinkled automatically.

notes:
CONJUGATION: {仕組|しく}む is a godan verb (む row). Te-form: {仕組|しく}んで. Passive: {仕組|しく}まれる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {罠|わな}を{仕組|しく}む (to set a trap)
- {陰謀|いんぼう}を{仕組|しく}む (to hatch a conspiracy)
- {仕組|しく}まれた{事件|じけん} (a staged incident)

RELATED: The noun {仕組|しく}み (mechanism, system, structure) is derived from this verb and is extremely common.
